verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for a SaaS payments platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents any way to choose where data is stored. The regional material covers currencies, local payment methods and where Agentic Commerce Suite is available, not data storage location, so it is not credited.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
